summary: This starter file shows the smallest practical shape for a rendered note page.

sections.title: Core Idea
items: Write compact explanations that can stand alone without the original Notion page.

examples.title: Example
examples.body: Turn a rough bullet into a checked explanation, then test it with a question.

mistakes: Leaving placeholders or uncited factual claims in the final note.

quickReview: Keep private source URLs blank and put public fact-check links in Sources.

questions.question: Private Notion page URLs should be committed in sample note metadata.
